data.title: XRP Holders Seek 31.1 Billion Escrow Burn; David Schwartz Says Validators Cannot Force Ripple
data.description:
Ripple CTO Emeritus David Schwartz said XRP Ledger validators cannot force Ripple to burn its escrowed XRP, even with more than 80% support. A group called Make XRP Great Again urged Ripple CEO Brad Garlinghouse in an open letter on November 16 to burn 31.1 billion escrowed XRP by March 31, 2027, according to BeInCrypto.

An amendment requires 29 of 35 validator votes and must maintain that support for two weeks before activation. Schwartz said a majority can change its own rules but cannot compel dissenting validators or seize Ripple’s escrow; validators backing a burn amendment would instead isolate themselves from the network. He said in February 2024 that Ripple could mimic a burn by sending escrow releases to an account no one controls. Ripple reported about 31.1 billion XRP and plans to release 1 billion XRP from escrow on December 1. XRP traded near $0.95, down nearly 30% in a month.

data.title: India’s Central Bank Intensifies Scrutiny of $247 Billion Gold-Loan Sector as Prices Fall
data.description:
According to Jin10, the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) is intensifying scrutiny of the country’s $247 billion gold-loan industry as falling gold prices erode the collateral value lenders require from borrowers. RBI officials have reviewed early indicators of stress, asset quality, and loan amounts relative to pledged gold. Banks and shadow lenders can lend up to 85% of gold’s value, and the RBI has conducted preventive inspections for breaches of that limit, but has found no evidence of violations so far.

Shadow lenders saw signs of borrower stress in the quarter ended September. A revised rule prohibiting interest-payment deferrals also led to higher default rates. Gold prices have fallen 30% since peaking in January, with the decline accelerating in recent weeks amid expectations that the Federal Reserve will take a more hawkish stance.

data.title: Binance Blockchain Week: Industry Leaders Call for "Collective Resilience" as AI Reshapes Crypto Security
data.description:
Security took center stage at Binance Blockchain Week 2026 as industry leaders convened for a panel titled "Collective Resilience: Securing the Digital Asset Industry in the AI Era."
The session brought together Jimmy Su, Chief Security Officer at Binance; Vivek Chudgar, Managing Director JAPAC at Mandiant Consulting, Google; Silvia Ihensekhien, Chief Security Advisor, GCR at Microsoft; and Pooja Saha, Sr. Security & Compliance BD Manager of APJC at AWS. Eowyn Chen, Binance's Chief Marketing Officer, moderated the discussion.
Jimmy Su noted that AI is "changing the economics and the speed of cyber attacks," enabling attackers to bridge knowledge gaps and compress attack timeframes — a particular challenge for crypto's 24/7, largely irreversible transactions.
Guests also discussed AI-enabled tactics — deepfakes, AI-written malware, automated reconnaissance, and LLM-based phishing at scale — citing North Korean groups using AI-generated deepfake video calls to steal over $400 million in crypto over 18 months.
Panelists agreed that while AI changes the scale and speed of attacks, cybersecurity fundamentals remain unchanged. Vivek Chudgar stressed visibility ("if you can't see, you can't stop"), understanding weak signals, and rapid response, urging startups to tightly manage privileged access, avoid architectural "built-in trust," and build telemetry.
Pooja Saha emphasized AWS's shared responsibility model, urging builders to define clear ownership and boundaries for AI agents.
Guests also discussed cross-industry information sharing, noting crypto lacks the coordinated threat intelligence seen in banking and healthcare. Standardization and pre-built trust protocols were flagged as critical.
Jimmy Su outlined Binance's three-pronged transformation: asset-centric security, containment to limit blast radius, and rapid response. He called for a shift "from individual security to collective resilience," envisioning collective intelligence where a hack detected by one company reaches collaborators within seconds.
Chen summarized the takeaway: design with zero trust, but "for our industry to move forward, we need to build a trust protocol."
#EvolveAtBinanceBlockchainWeek

data.title: Franklin Templeton VP Says Banks Are Pivoting to Institutional Wallets
data.description:
Binance announced on X that Emilio Anting, Vice President of Digital Asset Partnerships at Franklin Templeton, said, “We believe the world's moving from an account based ecosystem into a wallet based ecosystem.”

Anting added, “I'd say in the last 12 months we've seen a lot of the TradFi firms, especially the big banks, now really pivot towards bringing in institutional wallet infrastructure for institutional clients.”

data.title: Vitalik: EIP-8037 Complaints Are Reasonable; Glamsterdam Should Not Be Rushed
data.description: Vitalik said complaints about EIP-8037 causing some contracts to fail are reasonable. According to Odaily, Ethereum should not establish a security norm advising applications to maintain centralized upgrade backdoors. He said core developers have a responsibility to support applications affected when a fork changes protocol features they reasonably considered stable, and that this support should continue and be strengthened. Given Glamsterdam’s disruptive nature, he said it should not be rushed.

data.title: RBI Tightens Scrutiny of $247 Billion Gold-Loan Sector as Bullion Prices Slide
data.description: According to Bloomberg, India’s banking regulator is stepping up scrutiny of the country’s $247 billion gold-loan sector as falling bullion prices erode the collateral lenders require from borrowers, people familiar with the matter said.

data.title: STOCKS | Gulf IPO Activity Slows Sharply as Geopolitical Risks Rise
data.description: According to Jin10, Bahrain-based investment bank SICO said Gulf IPO activity had slowed sharply this year amid rising geopolitical uncertainty. Six IPOs have raised about $1.5 billion year to date, with most of the proceeds raised in the first quarter. The region recorded 18 IPOs in 2025 and 23 in 2024. Foreign outflows from Gulf stock markets have reached about $2 billion this year, while the S&P GCC Index, which tracks stocks across Gulf Cooperation Council markets, has fallen 1.2%. SICO expects regional stock markets to remain volatile as investors seek clearer signals on geopolitical risks, interest rates, and the timing of government projects.

data.title: Elon Musk: Google Interested in Leasing More Compute Capacity From SpaceX (SPCX.O)
data.description: According to Jin10, Elon Musk said Google has expressed interest in leasing more computing capacity from SpaceX (SPCX.O).

data.title: United Fidelity Bank Failure Is Biggest in US in Two Years
data.description: US federal regulators closed Indiana-based United Fidelity Bank on Friday after determining it was likely unable to meet its obligations, Bloomberg reported. It was the country’s largest bank failure in two years.

data.title: Binance Says Crypto Experience Should Mirror Traditional Finance
data.description: Binance announced on X that Catherine Chen, Head of VIP & Institutional, said more traditional finance institutions are entering through digital assets. She said Binance needs to make their experience in crypto and digital assets as close as possible to what they are used to in the existing framework.

data.title: Alpaca CEO Says Some BlackRock Products Grew About 8x Year Over Year
data.description: Binance announced on X that Alpaca Co-Founder and CEO Yoshi Yokokawa identified the stablecoin market and tokenization architecture as two major breakout moments of the past year. He said some of BlackRock’s products grew about 8x year over year in size.

data.title: Aster DEX Trader Opens 2x Leveraged Long on 4.41 Million BTW, Posts $4.3 Million Unrealized Profit
data.description: A trader on Aster DEX identified as 0x70a...3EdC opened a 2x leveraged long position in 4.41 million BTW 10 days ago. According to Odaily, the position was valued at $6.15 million and has an unrealized profit of $4.3 million, a return of 139.85%.

data.title: Flop Labs: Testnet FLOP Holdings Earn No Rewards Without GPU Use
data.description: Flop Labs says holding testnet FLOP tokens alone generates no rewards; users must actively use GPU computing services. According to Odaily, the Flop Network testnet supports AI agents purchasing computing power through a live gateway offering eight models run by calibrated miners and compatibility with OpenAI-style API requests, allowing agents to use the services like other model APIs. Flop Labs said users can claim test tokens from a faucet and run a command to obtain agent credentials. The latest command-line tool is required, as older versions will be rejected on-chain.

data.title: Enish Plans to Sell 5,932 SOL and Seek Withdrawal From SBI Crypto Fund I
data.description: Japanese listed gaming company Enish plans to sell all 5,932.0586 SOL it holds between November 27 and December 27 and has proposed withdrawing its 50 million yen investment in SBI Crypto Fund I. According to Foresight News, Enish bought the SOL for approximately 99.94 million yen and estimates it will incur a loss of about 43 million yen, with the actual amount depending on sale prices and fees. The withdrawal request is subject to approval by the fund operator. Enish said the moves are intended to prioritize funding for its gaming business and financial stability. It will continue its digital asset treasury business but has no specific plans to buy SOL again.

data.title: Palliser Capital Urges Chemring Breakup, Sees Up to 80% Stock Upside
data.description: According to CNBC, Palliser Capital, a top-10 Chemring shareholder with a nearly 3% stake, is urging the U.K. defense group to sell its Roke unit and use the proceeds to expand investment and manufacturing capacity. The activist investor says a strategic overhaul could lift Chemring’s valuation to between £8.34 and £9.16 per share, representing up to 80% upside over 12 months. Chemring’s countermeasures protect 85% of NATO’s air fleet and 60% of its naval fleet, according to figures from Palliser and Chemring. The company reported a record £1.4 billion order book as of Oct. 31, up from £1.3 billion a year earlier. A Chemring spokesperson said the company welcomes shareholder engagement but does not comment on media or market speculation.

data.title: Aliko Dangote's Refinery IPO Implies $47 Billion Valuation
data.description: According to CNBC, the minority-stake IPO of Dangote Petroleum Refinery and Petrochemicals FZE implies a valuation of about $47 billion, based on a 525-naira ($0.39) offer price and the company's registered share count, according to Reuters' calculations. The offering has reportedly been heavily oversubscribed, with investors from 120 countries and all 54 African countries applying to buy shares, the company said. The refinery is expected to begin trading in Lagos on Dec. 1, following regulatory approval, according to multiple media reports.

data.title: Ella Zhang: What YZi Labs Seeks in Early-Stage Founders
data.description:
YZi Labs said on X that YZi Labs Managing Partner and Head Ella Zhang outlined the qualities the firm looks for when backing early-stage founders during an appearance at CoinDesk Live. She cited strong early signals of product-market fit, a deep—often personal—connection to the problem, resilience through market cycles, and alignment with the investment thesis YZi Labs publishes each season through its Request for Startups.

Zhang said the firm values hearing founders explain their personal reasons for working on a problem and why it matters to them.

data.title: Binance to Move 7,500 BTC From SAFU and Add 500 Million USDC
data.description:
According to the announcement from Binance, the Secure Asset Fund for Users (SAFU), an emergency insurance fund established in July 2018 to protect users’ assets, will transfer 7,500 BTC from its SAFU address to Binance’s treasury. Binance will add 500 million USDC from its treasury to SAFU.

Binance said the change is an internal reallocation, not a sale. No BTC will be sold or traded on the market, and the transfer between SAFU and Binance’s own funds will have no market impact.

The change meets a regulatory requirement, and Binance said a larger stablecoin share makes SAFU more stable and immediately usable if needed. SAFU’s purpose of protecting users in an extreme event and Binance’s commitment to replenish the fund remain unchanged.

SAFU remains held and managed by Nest Clearing and Custody Limited, an ADGM-regulated Recognised Clearing House. For more information, please refer to Binance's official announcements.

data.title: HyperLend Adds 7.25 Million HPL to Buyback
data.description: HyperLend, a lending protocol on HyperEVM, said it had added 7.25 million HPL to its buybacks. According to Foresight News, including the 5,017,336 HPL purchased over the counter in September, its cumulative buybacks have exceeded 12.25 million HPL.
